entries.summary: Autonomous 12-hour sync expanded the verified fleet to 221 models (139 full 4/4 coverage, 82 early partial-source releases).
highlights: Newly indexed flagship releases include: Grok 4.20 Beta 1, ERNIE 5.1, Dola Seed 2.0 Pro, Grok 4.1, MiMo-V2-Pro, GPT-5.3 Chat.

entries.summary: Added November 2026 frontier and efficiency releases — Claude Fable 5.2 (Max, xHigh, High, Medium, Low), Inkling 2 Small, Muse Ember (Max), and Tencent Hy4 — expanding the verified fleet to 140 models with automated 12-hour incremental sync.
highlights: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 (Max) (65.0% AA Intelligence, 86.4% LiveBench, 71.85% Vals Index, 1568 Arena Coding Elo) and Claude Fable 5.2 (xHigh) (#1 LiveBench 2.0 release at 84.9%, #1 WebDev Arena) claim the #1 and #2 unified frontier spots.
Thinking Machines' Inkling 2 Small (released Nov 5, 2026; 1M context, 150 tok/s, $0.30/$1.00 per 1M tokens) debuts with 73.89% LegalBench and strong open-weights value efficiency.
Meta's Muse Ember (Max) ($0.10/$0.50 per 1M tokens, 60.48% Vals Index) and Tencent Hy4 (1M context open-weights reasoning model, 59.35% Vals Index) join the Pareto efficiency frontier.
Hardened 3-tier EntityResolver with autonomous model promotion and version/effort token signature guards so newly released models are ingested and ranked automatically every 12 hours.

entries.summary: Expanded fleet to 132 verified models with multi-effort reasoning variants (Max, xHigh, High, Medium, Low, Standard) and calibrated frontier grading (30% AA v5.0 / 30% LiveBench 2.0 / 25% Vals v2.2 / 15% Arena Text+Coding Elo).
highlights: Gemini 4 Carbon (High) (#1 AA Intelligence at 59.0%, #2 Vals Index at 70.36%) and Claude Opus 5.5 (Max) (#1 Arena Coding Elo at 1548, #3 LiveBench at 85.1%) lead the unified frontier at 97.65 and 97.16 pts.
Claude Fable 5.1 (Max) leads LiveBench 2.0 at 85.7%, while Claude Sonnet 5.5 (Max) leads Vals Enterprise Index v2.2 at 70.85%.
GPT-6 Astra (Max) (93.56 pts) and GPT-6.1 Sol (Max) (90.61 pts) anchor OpenAI's frontier ahead of prior-gen GPT-5.6 Sol (xHigh) (#30, 72.70 pts).

DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 (Max) leads open-weights models at 69.85 pts ($0.20/1M blended), while legacy DeepSeek-R1 (0528) (#108, 35.26 pts) and Llama 3.1 405B Instruct (#128, 14.49 pts) calibrate accurately into historical tiers.
Removed unverified model names (GPT-5.6 Mini/Nano, Qwen 3.8 Coder 32B, DeepSeek R2, Llama 4.1 405B) and replaced with verified upstream releases.

entries.summary: Added multi-effort thinking tiers across Anthropic Claude 5.5/5.1, OpenAI GPT-6 Astra/Sol/Terra/Luna, Google Gemini 4/3.8, Meta Muse Wonder/Spark, and xAI Grok 4.7.
highlights: Added explicit thinking_effort telemetry (max, xhigh, high, medium, low, none, standard) to measure accuracy vs. latency/cost scaling across reasoning effort levels.
